## Streamex Corp. to Present at the ThinkEquity Conference on October 15, 2026


October 6, 2026


[PDF Version](https://ir.streamex.com/node/12501/pdf)


WINTER PARK, Fla., Oct. 06, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Streamex Corp. (“Streamex” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: STEX), a technology company building the future of the commodity markets through tokenization, today announced that Christine Plummer, Chief Financial Officer, will present and host in-person one-on-one meetings with investors at the ThinkEquity Conference, taking place on October 15, 2026 at the Mandarin Oriental Hotel in New York City.


**Presentation Details**


The live presentation will begin at 4:00 p.m. ET on Thursday, October 15, 2026 at the Mandarin Oriental Hotel, 80 Columbus Circle, New York, NY. A live webcast of the presentation will be available on the Events page of the Streamex investor relations website at https://ir.streamex.com/news-events/events. A replay of the webcast will be available for 90 days following the presentation. Streamex will also host in-person one-on-one meetings with investors on Thursday, October 15, 2026. To register for the presentation or to request a one-on-one meeting, please contact ThinkEquity at conference@think-equity.com.


**About ThinkEquity**


ThinkEquity is a boutique investment bank that provides a suite of capital markets and advisory services to growth companies, including initial public offerings (IPOs), secondary offerings, confidentially marketed public offerings (CMPOs), registered direct offerings, at-the-market offerings (ATMs), debt placement and acquisition financing. The ThinkEquity Conference brings together U.S. and international public and private companies, industry executives, and institutional and accredited investors for company presentations and one-on-one meetings. For more information, visit www.think-equity.com.


**About Streamex Corp.**


Streamex Corp. (NASDAQ: STEX) is a technology and infrastructure company focused on the tokenization and digitalization of commodity real-world assets. Streamex delivers institutional-grade solutions that bridge traditional finance and blockchain-enabled markets through secure, regulated, and yield-bearing financial instruments.


For more information, visit[www.streamex.com.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=CYkgrUJbXvj0CwLkxOmUHEI7B6T-GfA5P4SAvKerDSLODttptqtRY8Xr6XJhQXnegN34YyQcz-ooGNHDqBFKcm-hUnNIuv6Wz-H2v2L9xMs=)
